title: 温酒请战
prompt:
Create a BRAND NEW landscape mythic Three Kingdoms story illustration, 1536x1024 or highest native landscape resolution. Title concept "温酒请战" (DO NOT write title on image). This is the grand coalition assembly before Guan Yu volunteers to fight, NOT a battle. The input silver card is ONLY reference for Guan Yu's SAME mature angular Chinese face, phoenix eyes, long black beard, green headwrap, green/white war robes over complete silver-dark scale armor with ornate gold trim, jade-accented SINGLE crescent glaive on a SINGLE rigid straight shaft. Do NOT copy its fighting pose or layout.
Composition: commanding near-foreground Guan Yu occupies the largest figure area slightly left of center, standing calmly ON THE GROUND beside an assigned coalition seating area, not on a chair. Both feet planted naturally, upright dignified volunteering stance, body three-quarter toward the council and face clearly visible, focused calm decisive eyes surveying the warlords. One hand holds his ornate crescent polearm upright at a slight diagonal, relaxed believable grip, other hand near chest in a restrained pledge/request gesture. His anatomy is simple and credible: one head, two arms/hands, two legs/feet, proper shoulders/hips. His broad crescent blade and single perfectly straight metal shaft are clear; sword stays ceremonial/at rest, no swing or attack.
Liu Bei and Zhang Fei stand a step behind his side beside their seats, smaller than Guan Yu, both ON THE GROUND and not sitting/standing on furniture. Zhang Fei: stocky broad coarse leopard-like face, thick eyebrows, large round fierce eyes, bushy black beard, deep forest-green heavy general armor, robust warrior not scholar. Exactly one Liu Bei, one Guan Yu, one Zhang Fei.
A secondary small Cao Cao is recognizable as a dignified navy/dark-armored military commander with sheathed sword, offering/raising ONE steaming warm wine cup near a nearby low command table as a subtle narrative clue. No fan, no scholar-only wide robe, no emperor crown or Lu Bu plumes. Do not let him compete with Guan Yu.
GRAND EIGHTEEN-WARLORD ANTI-DONG-ZHUO COALITION ASSEMBLY: broad EARTHBOUND late-Han assembly platform and huge open command pavilion, ranks of low tables and assigned seats, coalition leaders as small grouped silhouettes, many banners of different contingents, organized camp tents and army ranks receding into distant hills. Convey coalition scale through seating rows, flag formations and unified camp organization, NOT 18 equal detailed portraits. Architecture is grounded Chinese timber/stone/canvas, no floating palaces, no heavenly islands. Strong perspective depth through the assembly. Keep seats separate and clearly lower than standing heroes.
A majestic PURE EMERALD GREEN Chinese dragon SPIRIT naturally coils in the sky behind Guan Yu, large powerful head, thick neck and only a few continuous portions of body emerging through atmospheric clouds, no dense snake rings, no fragmented limbs/extra heads. Translucent divine presence not a physical monster attacking anyone.
Visual hierarchy: exceptionally clear Guan Yu face/eyes/armor and glaive first; dragon second; Liu/Zhang and Cao smaller; coalition setting broad subdued low contrast, softer lower-detail figures without arbitrary blur on anatomy. Mythic dimensional Japanese-influenced heroic manga game illustration with designed clean volumes, smooth face planes and broad robe folds, grand dramatic lighting without random spark confetti.
No Hua Xiong, no enemy duel, no decapitation, no blood, no blade collisions, no impact sparks, no attacking poses, no battlefield explosion. No written title, no captions, no UI, no frame or stars.
